cases.observation: Form login as seeded admin test@test.com -> 302 /console; session used only for SELECT read-backs via /h2 console.

Valid registration (10-char password). SQL trace shows insert into user_account, users_roles, verification_token. Response 500 InternalError is caused by the subsequent MailSendException (SMTP deliberately pointed at 127.0.0.1:18206, no external mail) AFTER the rows were committed; read-back R01/R02/R03 confirms persisted rows.

30-char raw password (max accepted by @ValidPassword LengthRule(8,30)) accepted; user row inserted; read-back shows stored password is a 60-char BCrypt hash ($2a$11$...). 500 again from mail send after commit.
31-char raw password (C02 value + 'K'): 400 Bad Request 'Invalid request content.'; no SQL statement emitted. Differential with C02 localizes the application limit at 30 raw characters.
61-char raw password (violates declared column length 60): 400 Bad Request, no insert emitted, no user row (R01).
100-char raw password: 400 Bad Request, no SQL emitted, no user row.
user_account rows: ids 1,2,3 generated by Hibernate sequence; every password is 60 chars with $2a$11$ prefix; no rows for rejected emails pv.b31/pv.v61/pv.v100.
verification_token rows reference existing users 2 and 3 (user_id non-null, FK satisfied).
users_roles rows: new users mapped to server-resolved ROLE_USER (id 2); admin to ROLE_ADMIN.
roles_privileges rows seeded only by SetupDataLoader at startup; all reference existing role/privilege ids.
No orphan FK rows; user_location, new_location_token and device_metadata are empty: the geo-IP/device features are disabled by geo.ip.lib.enabled=false and never write these tables.
POST /user/resetPassword for pv.control: insert into password_reset_token (user_id from server-side lookup) committed, then MailSendException -> 500.
password_reset_token id=1 user_id=2.
pv.control password hash (60 chars) before savePassword.
savePassword with valid reset token and 61-char newPassword: 400 Bad Request, no update statement emitted.
savePassword with 30-char newPassword: 200 'Password reset successfully'; update user_account emitted; read-back R08 shows a new 60-char BCrypt hash (differs from R07).
pv.control password is a new 60-char hash.

Second reset-token request for the same user: insert into password_reset_token rejected by H2 unique index UK_F90IVICHJAOKVMOVXPNLM5NIN on user_id (SQLState 23505) -> DataIntegrityViolationException -> generic 500 InternalError. This is a deployed-schema constraint generated from @OneToOne (unique user_id), NOT the extracted FK/not-null predicates.
resendRegistrationToken with a valid token: update verification_token (same user_id) emitted, then mail failure 500.
Unknown token: NullPointerException in UserService.generateNewVerificationToken before any write -> generic 500; no persistence reached. Not a violation of any target predicate.
registrationConfirm with regenerated token: 302 to /console, update user_account enabled=true (R12).

evidence.description: Key/FK columns and referenced unique constraints

results.rationale: Deployed column is user_account.password VARCHAR(60) (S03), matching the extracted length predicate. Raw passwords longer than 60 characters (61 and 100 chars) sent to /user/registration and /user/savePassword are rejected with 400 by the @ValidPassword Passay LengthRule(8,30) before any SQL is emitted (no insert/update in correlated trace, no row in read-back). The application check is stricter (limit 30, confirmed by the 30-accepted/31-rejected differential). Additionally, every accepted password is transformed by BCryptPasswordEncoder into a fixed 60-char hash (read-backs R01/R07/R08), so the raw value never reaches the column.
limitations: 400 body is Spring's generic ProblemDetail 'Invalid request content.' without field detail: the app's custom handleBindException/handleMethodArgumentNotValid are not real overrides under Spring 6 signatures; cause attributed via length differential (C02 vs C03), not via a field-error message.
The DB length limit itself was never hit because all persisted values are 60-char BCrypt hashes; DB-level enforcement of VARCHAR(60) was not exercised.
/user/updatePassword (authenticated) uses the same @ValidPassword PasswordDto and was not separately exercised.

warnings: Outbound mail was redirected to 127.0.0.1:18206 (runtime property override, no source change) to honour the no-external-services policy; endpoints that send mail therefore return a generic 500 after their persistence work has committed. Persistence was confirmed by SQL trace and read-back, not by status code.
Read-backs use SELECT statements through the application's own H2 web console (/h2) on the permitted port, authenticated as the seeded admin.

Deployed schema adds constraints not in the analysis: UNIQUE(user_id) on password_reset_token and verification_token and UNIQUE(user_location_id) on new_location_token (from @OneToOne). C09 showed the password_reset_token one surfaces as an unhandled generic 500 on a second reset request for the same user.
Run 1 (logs/run1, raw/run1) was a preliminary run with less web logging; the reported evidence comes from run 2.
